fnol_text: My name is Tariq Chukwu and I live at 775 Foxglove Court, Milton, VT 05454. You can reach me on (555) 640-6238 or tariq.chukwu@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 21 July 2025. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2025-00044. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Chukwu on (555) 640-6238 to acknowledge the claim. Tariq confirmed the loss date as 21 July 2025.
Site visit to 775 Foxglove Court. Neighbour Valentina Varga was present and confirmed the timeline.
Tariq sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
